'''''Battle of Echo Base''''' was an [[Artist/Legends|artist's]] [[Painting/Legends|rendition]] of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].

{{Stub}}

==Depiction==
The painting featured the appearance of two [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]], two [[Snowspeeder/Legends|Snowspeeders]] and many [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]].

==Behind the scenes==
''Battle of Echo Base'' is a painting that players of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' can obtain by achieving a "perfect" victory in the "Battle of Echo Base Heroic Encounter."
